clips.title: The story
paras: The Dalaran Status Report is a cache of sensitive intelligence compiled by the Kirin Tor wizards stationed at Ambermill in Silverpine Forest. It details the current state of the rebuilding city of Dalaran, making it a prized document for the Forsaken and the Deathstalkers of Undercity.

The Scourge sacked Dalaran and Archimonde brought down its towering spires during the Third War. Its surviving magi removed its protective shield early in the reconstruction and are rebuilding the city in the open. The Kirin Tor also maintains enclaves such as Ambermill in southeastern Silverpine Forest. The Dalaran Status Report contains intelligence about the state of Dalaran sought by the Deathstalkers.
